rationale: Calculated total impedance for each fault location (source + transformer + feeder). Computed 3-phase fault current using I_3ph = V_ll / (sqrt(3) * |Z|). Approximated 2-phase current as I_2ph = sqrt(3)/2 * I_3ph. Max 3ph current was 9.3055 kA. Min 2ph current was 1.5086 kA. Selected breaker rating as the smallest standard value (12.5 kA) exceeding max_3ph_fault_ka * safety_factor (10.236 kA). Selected relay pickup as the minimum value (450.0 A) satisfying both load margin (>= 450.0 A) and minimum fault sensitivity (<= 754.3 A) constraints.
